title: Microsoft Dataverse: agent users backed by Microsoft Entra agent identities
summary: Hold: the briefing infers an admin-opt-in arrival default from a manual provisioning procedure, rather than a statement of the default. Copying a person's security role does not necessarily give an agent access to the same records, and Microsoft documents identity-creation authorization routes that do not require an Entra administrator role.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The feature is admin-opt-in, nothing is added until an administrator acts, and agent-user creation is necessarily manual for every agent and environment.
claims.quote: Searched: "Entra agent users" "default" "Dataverse"; "Dataverse" "agent users" "automatically". Read Create users and Create Entra agent users. They document a manual route, not an exclusive route or the arrival behavior of existing agents.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to "unknown". Remove "Nothing is added until an admin does it" from the summary. Replace the second Why it matters paragraph with: "The roadmap says enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically. Learn documents an administrator adding an agent and assigning its security role, but does not state whether existing agents gain Dataverse access automatically." Replace the manual-step sentence under Change & support with: "Learn documents a per-environment procedure for adding an agent and assigning its security role." Remove "end users see nothing until an agent they use is given Dataverse access" from the impact rationale.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: A role copied from a human user gives the agent that user's reach.
claims.quote: Users can access records they own, objects that are shared with the organization, objects that are shared with them, and objects that are shared with a team that they're a member of.
claims.fix: Replace "A role copied from a human user gives the agent that user's reach" with "A copied role carries privileges, but access to particular records also depends on access levels, ownership and sharing." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/security-roles-privileges.

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: An agent user with a broad role acts with no person approving each action.
claims.quote: Searched: "Dataverse" "agent user" "approval". Read Create users and Create Entra agent users. The roadmap permits autonomous tasks, but neither feature page establishes the approval behavior of every agent using this identity.
claims.fix: Remove ", with no person approving each action". Retain the separately attributed roadmap statement that agents can act autonomously or on behalf of users.
